agents.name: Communications surveillance
agents.mission: Read every outbound draft and inbound client message, decide the supervisory regime, and hold anything that cannot go out as written.

agents.name: Record completeness
agents.mission: Compare what the advisor says they use against what is actually captured, and name the exposure on every gap.

agents.name: Recommendation evidence
agents.mission: Before a recommendation is released, check the care-obligation record is complete: basis, alternatives, costs, why this client.

agents.name: Client protection
agents.mission: Watch for exploitation indicators on specified adults, grievances that were never logged, and concentration past the household ceiling.

agents.name: Conduct
agents.mission: Outside business activities and private securities transactions, where the firm has switched the rule on.
